method: Natural land in the site cell is NLCD 2024 forest, shrub, grassland and wetland classes (41–43, 51–52, 71–74, 90 and 95) as a share of the cell. Landscape intactness is 1 minus the Global Human Modification index (Theobald et al., about 2016), averaged over the radius. Threatened species richness is the IUCN Red List 2025 count of Vulnerable, Endangered and Critically Endangered amphibians, birds, mammals, reptiles and freshwater fish on IUCN's ~10 km grid, averaged over the radius. Imperiled species richness is NatureServe's Map of Biodiversity Importance (contiguous US only), averaged over the radius. The critical habitat share is the share of the radius in USFWS final critical habitat, and the protected share is the share in PAD-US 4.1 fee lands with GAP status 1–3. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the facilities in view, with direction applied so a higher percentile means a greater potential impact; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range, and a facility with no value for a variable is left out of that variable's ranking. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. Neighbourhood variables use the H3 res-8 cells (about 0.7 km² each) whose centre lies within the chosen radius of the facility; site variables use the single res-8 cell that holds the facility point. All of this is provisional.
